info.title: Quarry Migration Tool
info.description: Code-first migration CLI for Quarry — schema diffing, code generation, and migration scaffolding via Roslyn

commands.name: convert
commands.description: Convert Dapper calls to Quarry chain API (--from dapper)

commands.name: create-scripts
commands.description: Generate full CREATE TABLE DDL from current schema

commands.name: add
commands.description:
Scaffold a new migration from schema changes
migrate add-empty <name> Create an empty migration for manual operations

commands.name: bundle
commands.description: Build a self-contained migration executable

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Preview schema changes without generating files

commands.name: list
commands.description: List all migrations

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove the latest unapplied migration

commands.name: script
commands.description: Generate incremental migration SQL for a version range

commands.name: squash
commands.description: Collapse all migrations into a single baseline

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show applied vs pending migration status (requires --connection)

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate migration integrity
